reviewed_hunks.quote: A 2026-11-08 targeted n-back search added one task-specific context record: Soveri et al. 2017 (PMID 28116702; *Psychonomic Bulletin & Review*; 203 effect sizes from 33 published randomized controlled n-back training trials in healthy adults; medium transfer to untrained n-back tasks, but very small effects on other working-memory tasks, fluid intelligence and cognitive control; no moderation by age, dose, single versus dual training, or verbal versus visuospatial content). The DOI and metadata were verified via PubMed esummary/efetch. It becomes the first N-back citation and tightens the core mechanic's brief, claim and qualifier from "closely related working-memory tasks" to "untrained n-back tasks, with little transfer beyond the task". The 2026 asymmetry meta-analysis (PMID 42711482) remains a supporting citation. The review is now 124 records and 286 outcomes, revision v1.8.
reviewed_hunks.note: Documented the targeted n-back search that surfaced the 2017 meta-analysis and its effect sizes.

reviewed_hunks.quote: **Methods.** PRISMA 2020 systematic umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses, supplemented by landmark RCTs. PubMed (1,495-review corpus plus ten scoping searches), OpenAlex citation chasing, ClinicalTrials.gov, and Crossref metadata verification. 2,360 unique bibliographic records and 363 trial records were screened; 124 records (90 primary, 34 context) and 286 outcomes were extracted, including November 2026 updates of six gaming-disorder engagement records, three photosensitivity safety records, one gamification record, three incentive-design records, three goal-setting records, two retrieval-practice records, two habit records, one gamification-caution record, one planning-interventions record, two mental-contrasting records, one test-anxiety record, one interleaving record, one engagement-prompts record, one adherence record, two self-determination-theory meta-analyses, two e-consent systematic reviews, two executive-function training meta-analyses, one Corsi/spatial-span meta-analysis, one spatial-training meta-analysis, one prospective-memory meta-analysis, one mnemonic-training meta-analysis, one judgments-of-learning reactivity meta-analysis and one n-back training meta-analysis. Certainty is recorded as reported by the source review; independent GRADE was not performed.
